body: DEFERRED SPINE TARGET — the requirement's last acceptance criterion calls for a new coherence test in `src/main.rs`, beside the existing `installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard` (which renders `rust.apg.tests.e2e.installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard`, `src/main.rs:4877-4940`). That test does not exist in the scanned branch graph, so no `implemented-by` edge targeting it is authored here. Per the parent-cannot-depend-on-the-child rule the plan-writer declares it as a planned Implementation node (its real `rust.apg...` FQN) with a `creates` task; the spec-writer never authors planned code. The other three acceptance criteria already reach real code through `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (the two prompt files) and `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` (`AGENTS.md`).
